title: Waystones Tweaks
description: Adds some useful features to the Waystones mod!
body:
[![alt text](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/aa8962f9-e6ff-4a83-8eeb-d145d3c55343.webp)](https://bisecthosting.com/Zoni25)

This is an Addon mod for the [Waystones](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/waystones) mod, so you need it as well!

### New Features

**Waystone Spawnpoint**

This feature is on by default, but can be turned off by setting the **waystoneSpawnpoint** game rule to False.

Players can **Shift + Right-click** on any Waystone to make it their spawnpoint. Should work on different dimensions as well.

**Waystone Sharing**

This feature is experimental and is off by default.

To turn it on you need to set the **waystoneSharing** game rule to True.

When on, every Waystone discovered by a player will immediately be shared with everyone online.
